configurations.name: api-local
runtimeArgs: cd apps/api && PAUSE_SECOND_FACTOR=true PORT=4000 APP_URL=http://localhost:3000 exec node --env-file=.env.test src/server.js

configurations.name: web-local
runtimeArgs: set -a && . apps/api/.env.test && set +a && PAUSE_SECOND_FACTOR=true API_URL=http://localhost:4000 NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=$SUPABASE_URL NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY NEXT_PUBLIC_MEDIA_BASE_URL=$SUPABASE_URL/storage/v1/object/public/$R2_PUBLIC_BUCKET NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=http://localhost:3000 NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY= NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN= exec npm run dev -w @carvo/web -- -p 3000
